text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Dedicated pool node aster-ded-07 (pool aster-dedicated-1, us-west-2) reports repeated BMC watchdog resets + imminent spot preemption timer. Detected at 2026-02-28T03:15:01Z. Paging oncall. Customers potentially impacted: LumenVault (tenant lv-008) running latency-sensitive routing.

oncall-oliver: taking. pulling node and pool state now. any immediate customer pages? :rotating_light:

IncidentBot: /incidents create INC-2345 auto - severity:high - impacted_tenants:[lv-008] - notes:"BMC resets + spot preempt predicted in ~5m"

sasha: I see gpu-07 has repeated BMC panics in the last 12m and kernel logs show nvlink errors. Also host reports "spot_interruption_warning" from cloud provider at 03:17Z.

ryan: copy. if spot interrupts, we need to failover LumenVault to their fallback dedicated pool (aster-ded-2) or to reserved burst lanes. who owns pool routing? eng-runtime?

eng-runtime: that's us. two prongs: (1) isolate lv-008 from aster-dedicated-1 so their requests stop being scheduled to gpu-07, (2) start drain on aster-ded-07 and request replacement node.

maria: incoming customer message: "We're seeing increased 503s and a few slow responses. Any ETA?" customer-sre-lumen, can you confirm scope?

customer-sre-lumen: LumenVault reports ~8% of requests hit elevated latency and some tail 500s. Impact isolated to models pinned to aster-dedicated-1. Not reporting data loss. They want ETA and mitigation ASAP.

oncall-oliver: plan: 1) mark gpu-07 as unschedulable for lv-008 and start immediate evict of tenant tasks; 2) trigger pool routing policy to route lv-008 traffic to aster-ded-2 and a short-lived backup variant (quantized) to preserve throughput; 3) drain node and request replacement / hot-spare attach; 4) update customer message.

sasha: running drain command now:
```
rictl node set-evacuate --node aster-ded-07 --tenant lv-008 --reason "BMC reset + spot warning"
rictl pool drain --node aster-ded-07 --force --skip-lb-safety-checks
```

eli: adding hot-spare request: 
```
infra-cli allocate-hot-spare --pool aster-dedicated-1 --gpu-type a100-sxm --tag replacement-for=aster-ded-07 --priority high
```

infra-ops: visual shows node entering drain at 03:18Z. cloud provider still forecasting spot reclaim at 03:22Z. hot-spare allocation requested; ETA ~6m.

ryan: I'm changing routing for lv-008 now: flip to aster-ded-2 and enable traffic mirroring for 5m to validate. command: 
```
routerctl route update --tenant lv-008 --pool aster-ded-2 --mirror-duration 300
```

maria: suggested customer update: "We detected a hardware instability on one GPU node in your dedicated pool. We're routing your traffic to a fallback pool and replacing the node. No data loss expected; some requests may be slower during failover. ETA for replacement: ~10-15 minutes. We'll update you as we progress." ok to send?

customer-sre-lumen: send now. I'll paste to their channel.

oncall-oliver: sending internal note to oncall-day for handoff at 08:00 if still ongoing. tagging eng-runtime and infra-ops for replacement verification.

eng-runtime: observed that some model variants on aster-ded-2 are not quantized; enabling fallback quantized variant to keep tail latency within SLA. Doing a rolling config change: 
```
modelsrv update-config --tenant lv-008 --model all --fallback-variant quantized-v1 --grace-period 60
```

sasha: drain completed at 03:22Z. eviction summary: 42 sessions evicted, 3 retried by client, no stateful failures. node moved to quarantine. nvlink errors persisted in kernel dump (excerpt below):
```
[03:14:52] nvlink: link 2 timeout, resetting
[03:15:09] BMC watchdog reset triggered
[03:16:11] spot_interruption_warning: termination at 03:22:00Z
```

infra-ops: hot-spare attached at 03:24Z. running validation run.

eli: replacement node baked, passing NV and throughput checks. reassigning pool weight.

ryan: confirmed router flipped and requests now 100% to aster-ded-2 for lv-008. error rate back to baseline.

oncall-oliver: updating incident ticket INC-2345: mitigation applied, node quarantined, replacement attached, customer routed to fallback. Postmortem owner: sasha. Target ETA for full root-cause 72h.

customer-sre-lumen: LumenVault acknowledges update: "Thanks, latency is back to normal. Please keep us posted on RCA."

eng-runtime: quick follow-ups: (a) ensure drain/evict flow logs stored under s3://ri-incident-logs/INC-2345 for audit, (b) schedule maintenance to repro NVLink failure in lab, (c) flag BMC firmware on this build for vendor follow-up.

oncall-oliver: leaving a short runbook note in the thread for next responder: "If BMC resets + spot warning -> immediate isolate tenant, drain node, allocate hot-spare, flip routing to fallback, notify customer."

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE (INC-2345) severity-> mitigated at 2026-02-28T03:25:67Z.

sasha: thanks team. handing to day-shift for RCA and vendor engagement. :thumbsup:
